class Customer(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'customer'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String)
    balance = Column(Integer)
    credit_limit = Column(Integer)
models.description: Customer model storing customer information and derived balance.
models.name: Customer

models.code:
class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'order'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    customer_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('customer.id'))
    amount_total = Column(Integer)
    date_shipped = Column(DateTime)
    notes = Column(String)
models.description: Order model storing order details, associated with a customer.
models.name: Order

class Item(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'item'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    order_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('order.id'))
    product_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('product.id'))
    amount = Column(Integer)
    quantity = Column(Integer)
    unit_price = Column(Integer)
models.description: Item model storing items included in an order.
models.name: Item

class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'product'

rules.name: Check Customer Balance Constraint
rules.description: Ensure customer's balance is less than their credit limit.
rules.code:
Rule.constraint(validate=Customer,
                as_condition=lambda row: row.balance <= row.credit_limit,
                error_msg="Customer balance ({row.balance}) exceeds credit limit ({row.credit_limit})")

rules.name: Calculate Customer Balance
rules.description: Customer balance as the sum of pending order totals.
rules.code: Rule.sum(derive=Customer.balance, as_sum_of=Order.amount_total, where=lambda row: row.date_shipped is None)

rules.name: Order Shipping Event
rules.description: Send order data to Kafka if shipped.
rules.code: Rule.after_flush_row_event(on_class=Order, calling=kafka_producer.send_row_to_kafka, if_condition=lambda row: row.date_shipped is not None, with_args={"topic": "order_shipping"})
